project.audience: Specify actual buyer/user with job and comparable maturity, not generic everyone
project.actual_offer: Actual product, offer, terms and verified features, not competitor promises
project.first_value: The first actual completed user task after CTA/signup, with observable success
project.protected_constraints: Brand identity, licenses, private data, pricing, consent, routing and billing limits

research.selection_rationale: Explain why selected leading references serve this exact market and user job
research.shortfall_reason: Explain missing competitor coverage if fewer than six direct sources were inspected

competitors.access_limit: Example only; NOT_INSPECTED. Replace with real public browser audit and authorized flow before using as a benchmark

scenes.visitor_question: Record the exact question this real source scene answers
scenes.headline_strategy: Analyze what the headline promises and its specificity; do not paste copyrighted text
scenes.body_copy_strategy: Analyze writing structure, tone, length, objections, sequence and every meaningful copy item
scenes.cta_and_proof: Analyze all real CTA labels by semantic role, next step and nearby substantiation
scenes.composition: Record the visible hierarchy, proportions, asset crop, whitespace, type and composition
scenes.media_and_motion: Record media and actual animation states/triggers or explicit absence after inspection
scenes.mobile_behavior: Describe real mobile reflow and information order, not assumed responsive behavior

text_items.observed_purpose: Paraphrase what the heading helps this user decide, without reproducing competitor copy
text_items.strategy: Analyze its claim type, tone, concrete mechanism, sentence length and proof relationship

text_items.observed_purpose: Identify the real action and where it leads, not merely the button color
text_items.strategy: Analyze action verb, hierarchy and expectation set by the CTA

media_items.observed_role: Not yet observed; replace with actual photos, videos, authentic UI or deliberate absence after browsing

steps.control_and_feedback: Replace with observed fields, back/skip/error states, screenshots and next action
steps.branching_and_errors: Record actual skip, back, defaults, errors and feedback after authorized inspection

surfaces.user_decision: What the target visitor must know and do at this point
surfaces.copy_strategy_transfer: Write original wording that performs the same observed persuasion job
surfaces.composition_transfer: Specify the exact layout mechanism, hierarchy and proportion built from the reference
surfaces.media_motion_transfer: Show truthful product media and functional movement with verified assets
surfaces.departure_rationale: Explain exactly which source mechanics were kept and any necessary deviations
surfaces.brand_and_rights_boundary: Do not copy trade dress, proprietary words, photos, animations, characters or code

flows.step_by_step_transfer: Describe observed-to-target flow, all applicable states and mandatory divergences

steps.feedback_and_errors: Describe real target form, recovery and return states

review.side_by_side_analysis: Replace with real reference/old/new desktop and phone observations, including what was cut

critical_findings.description: Example only: cannot ship after inspecting just a competitor hero
